cases.description: When a Zone is newly created and no SOA record has been added, getSOA() should return null.

cases.expected: instance of SOARecord that was added to the Zone
cases.description: After adding a valid SOARecord to the Zone (e.g., via addRecord or addRRset), getSOA() must return the same SOARecord instance, confirming that the internal SOA field is correctly set.

cases.expected: instance of SOARecord with expected field values
cases.description: Create an SOARecord with known values (mname, rname, serial, refresh, retry, expire, minimum). Add it to the Zone, then call getSOA() and verify that all fields of the returned SOARecord match the original values, ensuring that the method does not alter the record.
If the SOARecord is removed from the Zone (e.g., via removeRecord), subsequent calls to getSOA() should return null, confirming that the internal SOA reference is cleared appropriately.

cases.expected: instance of the second SOARecord added
cases.description: Add an initial SOARecord to the Zone, then add a different SOARecord (e.g., with a different serial). The second addition should replace the internal SOA reference, so getSOA() must return the second SOARecord instance.

cases.expected: instance of the SOARecord contained in the RRset
cases.description: Create an RRset that contains a single SOARecord, add it to the Zone using addRRset(RRset). After the call, getSOA() should return that SOARecord, confirming that addRRset correctly updates the internal SOA field.

group: SOA retrieval - non‑SOA records do not affect SOA

cases.description: Add a non‑SOA record (e.g., an ARecord) to a freshly created Zone. Since no SOARecord has been added, getSOA() must still return null, proving that unrelated record types do not modify the SOA reference.

group: SOA retrieval - removal of unrelated records

cases.description: Add a valid SOARecord and also add an unrelated ARecord. Remove the ARecord using removeRecord(Record). The SOARecord should remain untouched, so getSOA() must still return the original SOARecord.

group: SOA retrieval - zone cleared via iterator removal

cases.description: Add an SOARecord to the Zone, obtain an iterator over the Zone's RRsets, and remove every RRset via the iterator's remove() method (or by calling removeRecord on each Record). After all records are removed, getSOA() should return null, confirming that the internal SOA reference is cleared when the zone becomes empty.
